# RAG Diagnosis Repository Index

Use this file as the quick routing map for AI coding agents.

## Read First

1. `AGENTS.md` - repo-level safety and workflow rules.
2. `README.md` - legacy project overview and environment notes.
3. `docs/harness-engineering/README.md` - harness operating model.
4. `presentation/v12d/README.md` - canonical V12d defense deck package.

## Main Work Areas

- Pipeline code: `rag/pipeline/`
- Pipeline tests: `rag/tests/`
- Query/config contracts: `rag/configs/`
- Local demo backend/UI: `demo/flutter/`
- Final defense package: `presentation/v12d/`
- Selected experiment traces: `experiments/structured_cases_v4_2_2_rtx6000/`
- Dataset ledger: `data/whole_multicare_dataset/`

## Clinical-Safety Boundary

This repository supports research evaluation and thesis demonstration only. It
does not provide clinical advice, deployment-ready triage, or image-only
diagnosis.
